note: Two campgrounds on Lake Wappapello: Asher Creek, on an open slope above a lake arm, and the wooded Ridge loops. --Claude
summary: MO 2027 sheet: Asher Creek basic $16 / electric $24-26 (Apr-Oct only), Ridge electric $19-21 on-season, $14-16 off-season; 73 bookable sites (Asher Creek 27, Ridge 46) 33-87 ft, 50A; showers seasonal. Lakeview confirmed from Asher Creek. Not split: Asher Creek and Ridge are ~300 m apart off the same park road. Season stays as recorded (manual, 2026-10-20).
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview): confirmed. Asher Creek's sites 64-73 sit on an open grassy slope above the lake arm, ~50-80 m from the summer-pool shoreline with no woods between and an open sightline to the water (the imagery is at winter drawdown, showing the arm's mudflats). The lakeview call rests on Asher Creek; the Ridge sites are all in woods (sites 26-29 ~60 m from the east arm through trees). Not upgraded: a slope and the campground road separate the pads from the water.

No split: Asher Creek (centroid 36.9378,-90.3343) and Ridge (sites 1-11 around 36.9374,-90.3309; sites 12-47 to the south and east) are ~300 m apart, both reached from the same park road; under the ~1 km rule they stay one entry.
Pin: 36.9421,-90.3434 sits in woods ~940 m NW of the campgrounds; suggest 36.9375,-90.3330 (between Asher Creek and the Ridge entrance).
Phone: the camping page lists only the statewide reservation line 877-422-6766; no park phone recorded here.
